c00.name: Enders
c00.tip: Living machines, tall and gray, made to destroy. They do not think; something vast and cold made them to kill on instinct.

c00.name: the nest
c00.tip: The place where Obsidia's kind sleep until they are needed. Obsidia grew a thing of her own there that looks like a little girl.

c01.name: the Catastrophe
c01.tip: The disaster of 978. In the years after it the Enders were everywhere, and they nearly wiped out humanity.

c01.name: aspirant power
c01.tip: The belief that runs the mecha suits. Those with enough of it to pilot a suit are called Aspirants.

c01.name: the VR Battlefield
c01.tip: The Academy hall where students fight simulated Enders inside pods. A big screen above the pods shows each run, and a board ranks the times.

c02.name: Layla's cannon
c02.tip: The cannon Layla built, as tall as she is, white with a teal strip. Cyan cells on its stock fill as it charges. She calls it her magic gun.

c02.name: the alley thing
c02.tip: Fanny's tactic: fight with your back to a narrow alley, so the Enders must come at you one or two at a time.

c03.name: Ender ranks
c03.tip: Joe's three ranks: Ultimate Enders, the deadliest, which release the others; then Super Enders; then plain Enders, which kill the most.

c03.name: Storm Citadel
c03.tip: Obsidia's ship. It hangs over the bay inside its own black cloud, and wherever its violet storm reaches, human machines die.

c03.name: lull
c03.tip: Joe's word for the weeks the Enders go quiet after they are badly hurt. A lull always ends.

c04.name: Defensive Bubble
c04.tip: A dome of light over the city of Terrinia. It keeps the Enders out. A brighter patch of new light covers a tear from the last attack.

c04.name: the first rule of Enders
c04.tip: Joe's lesson: Enders show their weak spot only when they attack. The chest plates split, the core glows, and that moment is all you get.

c05.name: Energy System
c05.tip: A white-cyan beam inside turning rings on the Academy's tallest tower. It feeds the dome and turns its dark hexagons pale again.

c06.name: rescue teams
c06.tip: The people who go into the ruins after a strike and carry out whoever is still alive.

c07.name: the sergeants' line
c07.tip: The Shield sergeants' saying, which Fanny opens every session with: "There is no place for mercy on the battlefield."

c07.name: the leftward drift
c07.tip: A fault in Layla's cannon: at full charge the shot pulls left, a hand's width at two hundred meters. Each test ends in ERROR.

c08.name: Aspirant pairs
c08.tip: Aspirants fight in pairs. Two who trust each other pull more out of a suit than the same two apart, and nobody knows why.

c08.name: the gate portal
c08.tip: A tall frame by the Academy's main gate that fills with light. Step in, and you come out at the breach.

c09.name: Oro
c09.tip: Ruby's home world, in another galaxy under a violet sky. Its will is Balance, and nobody there may grow strong enough to upset the order.

c09.name: Balance
c09.tip: In Ruby's lessons, the order that keeps everything in place after a first burst of chaos. The books call it the Will of the Cosmos.

c09.name: Cosmic Reapers
c09.tip: Oro's android soldiers from Project Angel: hundreds of the same girl, with animal ears and magenta eyes. They do only what they are told.

c10.name: Will of the Planet
c10.tip: Ruby's lesson says some worlds grow a will of their own as they age, even far ones like Dawnbreak. Oro's will, it says, is Balance.

c10.name: Angela's shield
c10.tip: A pane of pale light that flies from Angela's palm and opens in front of her, wide as a door. She calls "Deploying shield!"

c10.name: Balance Keepers
c10.tip: Oro's special forces. They go from planet to planet to keep things in "balance," and they want a blade sharper than any they have.

c11.name: the Council
c11.tip: Oro's rulers, who agree their orders in the Council hall. Angela was built on its order as its weapon.

c11.name: the trojan
c11.tip: A few lines Ruby hides under Angela's walking routines, behind a lock that opens to her hand alone. They are her way out of Oro.

c11.name: Dawnbreak
c11.tip: The planet humanity lives on. The Shield of Dawnbreak, the army that fights the Enders, is named for it.

c12.name: the Rioters
c12.tip: What Oro's mission order calls the people it is sent to save. Ruby knows what saving them really means.

c12.name: the Council's control unit
c12.tip: A sealed plate between the shoulder blades of every Project Angel body, with the Council's seal burned in. Ruby is never allowed to open it.

c13.name: S·L·K
c13.tip: The mark of Selrick, stamped on the students' jackets and shirts.

c13.name: Code Override
c13.tip: Ruby's power. Green lines run from her glove onto a machine and rewrite its orders.

c14.name: Decisionmakers
c14.tip: The Decisionmakers give the orders that Oro's Council agrees. Ruby's father leads them.

c14.name: giant Enders
c14.tip: Enders of giant size. One stands over the roofs of burning Terrinia, taller than any tower.

c15.name: Ruby's scythe
c15.tip: Ruby's scythe, white and orange and taller than she is. Lightning crawls along its blade, and one swing cuts through a row of androids.

c16.name: cleansing
c16.tip: The Council's word for a planet's fate. Cleansed means nobody on it is left outside Balance.

c16.name: AI droids
c16.tip: Slim white helper robots with one orange eye. Half serve the Combat Division and half the Support Division.

c17.name: Science Division
c17.tip: The Academy division that designs its suits and mends its machines. Chang'e is its director.

c17.name: Lesley's eye
c17.tip: A machine eye behind the dark visor on Lesley's left side, glowing teal. Chang'e built it.

c17.name: the research base
c17.tip: A research base that stood before the Academy. Chang'e and her parents lived there, and later Lesley stood at its door.

c18.name: Lesley's dream
c18.tip: Lesley's recurring nightmare: screams, the Enders' roar, and running the wrong way through a crowd. It always ends on a child's voice.

c18.name: Obsidia's storm
c18.tip: A black cloud over the bay with violet light moving inside it, and something in it too big for any cloud.

c19.name: Shield of Dawnbreak
c19.tip: The army soldiers formed to fight the Enders, named for their planet, Dawnbreak. Fanny's family were Shield soldiers.

c19.name: Ender core
c19.tip: The glowing heart inside an Ender's chest. It shows only when the chest plates split for a strike, and a shot into it kills the Ender.

c19.name: Terrinia
c19.tip: Humanity's last city, where the survivors of the Ender attacks drew back. Its dome of light, the Defensive Bubble, keeps the Enders out.

c20.name: Ender plating
c20.tip: Gray plates from dead Enders, tagged and numbered on the research base's benches. So far they have told the scientists nothing.

c21.name: the storm night of 983
c21.tip: In 983 the Storm Citadel's violet storm kills every human machine, and Obsidia's Enders strike the sleeping city after midnight.

c22.name: the design log
c22.tip: Chang'e's design log. It begins the night Lesley came back muddy, and every entry is written to Lesley.

c22.name: regulation
c22.tip: Lesley hands back anything that is not Shield regulation, like the rifle lamp and heated gloves Chang'e built for her.

c23.name: the core component
c23.tip: A piece that split off whole when Lesley's round cracked an Ender's core at the edge. Nobody had thought it could be done.

c23.name: the frame
c23.tip: A frame of steel tube in the shape of a person, with an Ender core piece caged in its chest. A soldier would wear it: the first suit ever built.

c23.name: the first light
c23.tip: The moment the light in the frame's core holds for good. Chang'e's mother gives it that name.

c24.name: the black-and-gold giant
c24.tip: A giant Ender hundreds of meters tall, black and gold, on tall thin legs, with huge curved blades hanging from its arms. It walks without hurry.

c25.name: Lesley's comm
c25.tip: The radio at Lesley's collar, with a small green light. Both the base and the Shield can reach her on it.

c26.name: aspirant power
c26.tip: The belief that runs the mecha suits. Those with enough of it to pilot a suit are called Aspirants.

c26.name: crescents
c26.tip: Floating crescent pieces Chang'e builds to keep herself safe. White edged with pink, they rise and circle her.

c27.name: the panels of light
c27.tip: Panels of light that open in the air around Chang'e when she says "Console! Activate!" She reads Enders through them.

c27.name: First Aspirants
c27.tip: The name the Academy later gives Lesley and Chang'e, after the night the two of them bring down three giant Enders over Terrinia.

c28.phrase: a glove wired to a dial
c28.name: the glove and dial
c28.tip: A glove wired to a dial that reads aspirant power. A hand goes in, the glove hums and lights, and the needle swings.

c28.name: wings of light
c28.tip: Wings of light that open at a pilot's back and let them fly. They run on aspirant power and go out like a switch when it is spent.

c29.name: checks
c29.tip: Chang'e's inspections of Angela. Anything that can receive can be told what to do, so Angela stays on checks.

c29.name: the trojan
c29.tip: A few lines Ruby hides under Angela's walking routines, behind a lock that opens to her hand alone. They are her way out of Oro.

c30.name: the field roster
c30.tip: The rotation: the list of instructors who fight Enders outside the dome. The breach took four names off it.

c30.name: the Academy hall
c30.tip: The Academy's ceremony hall. Rows of chairs face an altar with five great stars above it, and a tall window throws colored light.

c30.name: chibi keychains
c30.tip: A chibi keychain is a tiny big-headed doll. Guinevere wears a black-haired Vexana, and Vexana a pink-haired Guinevere.

c31.name: the gate portal
c31.tip: A tall frame by the Academy's main gate that fills with light. Step in, and you come out at the breach.

c31.name: Guinevere's drones
c31.tip: Two round gray drones with cat ears and yellow ring eyes. They circle Guinevere, fight beside her and run on her aspirant power.

c32.name: Hester's count
c32.tip: Hester, of the House's guard, counted "One. Two. Three." whenever little Guinevere fell, and Guinevere stood up on three.

c32.name: House Baroque
c32.tip: One of Terrinia's great money houses, run by a board with Guinevere's father in the head seat. It lent the city money for the dome's power.

c32.name: a lady's refinement
c32.tip: A manners tutor's phrase for how a lady holds her back. Guinevere glued it to Hester's count of three, and says it after every fall.

c33.name: the march
c33.tip: An old march Vexana's father hummed while he worked, always stopping in the same place. He would finish it when the war did.

c33.name: Stay back
c33.tip: The two words Vexana's father said whenever the drill bell rang, before he went up to his gun.

c33.name: the Shield's home
c33.tip: The Shield's home for soldiers' children, behind its barracks. It runs on bells, and most children there lost someone to the Enders.

c34.name: preparatory course
c34.tip: The Combat Division's year of training before any real fight. Cadets whose needle passes the line at the assessment go there.

c34.name: the final combat trial
c34.tip: The last trial of the preparatory course, scored by the instructors. It never goes on the rankings board and decides nothing but pride.

c35.name: the training hall
c35.tip: The Academy's sparring hall. At night it is dark but for one lamp on a chain over the heavy bag, and a gallery runs high above its door.

c36.name: Team-Up Day
c36.tip: The day the preparatory course ends, when cadets ask each other to be partners. A banner over the courtyard reads THE ASPIRANTS TEAM-UP DAY.

c36.name: Aspirant pairs
c36.tip: Aspirants fight in pairs. Two who trust each other pull more out of a suit than the same two apart, and nobody knows why.

c37.name: the reserve
c37.tip: A short sheet for cadets with no partner. They go out as singles behind the pairs and clear up after them.

c37.name: the dome's foot
c37.tip: A ward of warehouses at the city's edge, where the dome's curve meets the ground at the end of the main road.

c38.name: Guinevere's plans
c38.tip: Training plans Guinevere slips under Vexana's door in three colors: pink for her, violet for Vexana, gold for the rest. Vexana does all of it.

c38.name: the team test
c38.tip: A pair test. Two stand in a chalk square while steel dummies come down six rails at once, and a pair is out if a steel arm touches either.

c39.name: debts
c39.tip: Vexana's belief that every gift is a debt. She thinks she owes her father a life, and pays it back in Enders.

c39.name: Emblems of Hope
c39.tip: Two gold stars Guinevere cut and soldered by hand, one for her collar and one for Vexana's. They glow gold when the partners' powers are in sync.

c40.name: the girls' house
c40.tip: A cake shop halfway down the hill from the Academy, under a pink awning. Only girls go in, and they all know what to order.

c40.name: the white box
c40.tip: A white cake box from the girls' house. Vexana keeps the summer's keepsakes in it: ticket stubs, a paper fan and a folded napkin.

c41.name: Best Aspirant Duo
c41.tip: Once a year the instructors give a pair of blue shield badges to the best Aspirant Duo. Guinevere and Vexana win the first ever given.

c41.name: Will of the Planet
c41.tip: Ruby's lesson says some worlds grow a will of their own as they age, even far ones like Dawnbreak. Oro's will, it says, is Balance.

c41.name: Mother Matrix
c41.tip: Chang'e's name for the body the readings suggest the Will of the Planet has: something vast, far out where nobody can see.

c42.name: Control Core
c42.tip: Whatever steers all the Enders, Chang'e says. It is hidden in the Will's dark void, and only destroying it can defeat the Will.

c42.name: the void
c42.tip: The dark past the edge of the Enders' portals, where every reading drops to nothing. Nobody can get near it.

c42.name: the black hole
c42.tip: A place in space so heavy it swallows whatever comes too near. Nothing seen falling in has come back out, not even light.

c43.name: an Aspirant's light
c43.tip: The key idea of Chang'e's paper: the part of you that thinks and hopes would keep shining inside a black hole and find its way home.

c43.name: Plan A and Plan B
c43.tip: Guinevere's two plans. Plan A: she smashes the Core and they win. Plan B: they come home. She makes Vexana say it.

c44.name: Partners tell each other first
c44.tip: A rule Guinevere and Vexana make after a drawn match: partners tell each other first, both of them.

c44.name: the Investigation Room
c44.tip: The Science Division's wing, where Ender wreckage is taken apart to learn how it works.

c45.name: pink-haired keychain
c45.tip: A little pink-haired keychain doll of Guinevere. Guinevere pressed it into Vexana's palm at a stall: "Now you have me on yours."

c45.name: the Investigation Room corridor
c45.tip: A long pale corridor in the Investigation Room wing, with tall windows down one side. Two of them are smashed in.

c46.name: Missing
c46.tip: The status on a file when someone is lost with no trace. A student says Missing is what they write first.

c46.name: black-haired keychain
c46.tip: A tiny big-headed Vexana with long black hair, from the park. Guinevere clips it to her arm guard, where her fist swings.

c47.name: the observation lab
c47.tip: A glass room at the top of the Academy's tower, with a long telescope. Ruby and Angela keep the tower's sensor array running there.

c47.name: the dead ground
c47.tip: The ruins outside the dome. Its streets have stood empty since the Catastrophe: doorways with no doors, weeds in every crack.

c48.name: the Catastrophe
c48.tip: The disaster of 978. In the years after it the Enders were everywhere, and they nearly wiped out humanity.

c48.name: Emblems of Hope
c48.tip: Two gold stars Guinevere cut and soldered by hand, one for her collar and one for Vexana's. They glow gold when the partners' powers are in sync.

c49.name: Mother Matrix
c49.tip: Chang'e's name for the body the readings suggest the Will of the Planet has: something vast, far out where nobody can see.

c49.name: the void
c49.tip: The dark past the edge of the Enders' portals, where every reading drops to nothing. Nobody can get near it.

c49.name: the first rule of Enders
c49.tip: Joe's lesson: Enders show their weak spot only when they attack. The chest plates split, the core glows, and that moment is all you get.

c50.name: the outer ward's fence
c50.tip: A wire fence twice Guinevere's height, with one lamp over its gate. Past it the dome comes down to the dead ground.

c50.name: the Will's mark
c50.tip: A cold point behind Vexana's breastbone. Through it the Will speaks, its Enders run with her, and its doors open wherever it sends her.

c51.name: the hollow
c51.tip: A fold of the dark that no line of Enders ever crosses. Vexana stays there, keeps her school clothes there and trains alone.

c51.name: the Singularity
c51.tip: A tear shaped like a four-pointed star, showing night sky over the bay. The Enders are widening it into a door to Vexana's world.

c51.name: feeders
c51.tip: Vexana's name for gray Enders that tear girders and dead Enders out of the ruins and carry the metal back through the door.

c52.name: Team-Up Day
c52.tip: The day the preparatory course ends, when cadets ask each other to be partners. A banner over the courtyard reads THE ASPIRANTS TEAM-UP DAY.

c53.name: Eternal Guards
c53.tip: Giant machines Vexana builds from Ender plate and cracked cores. They run on her power, and she means them to stand over Guinevere.

c53.name: Storm Citadel
c53.tip: Obsidia's ship. It hangs over the bay inside its own black cloud, and wherever its violet storm reaches, human machines die.

c54.name: Imperatrix
c54.tip: Obsidia's title. She is the Storm Citadel's Imperatrix, its empress, and the ship answers to her and to no one else.

c54.name: the pulse
c54.tip: The body's signal: one line down to every Ender, felt at once in every cell. It tells them where to go and what to do.

c54.name: the recall
c54.tip: An order written into the cells of one creature that says one thing: come back. Obsidia sends them to her pawn, and none is obeyed.

c55.name: recalibration
c55.tip: The body's healing. Living violet strands close cracks in Obsidia's shell, and set a made thing back to what it was made for.

c55.name: the Will's thread
c55.tip: Obsidia says each Ender's core is where the Will's thread ends. What an Ender sees runs back up the line to the Will.

c56.name: Twilight Orb
c56.tip: A sphere of light bursting open. Obsidia says it is the one memory the oldest pulses carry, and thinks the Will was born of it.

c56.name: host
c56.tip: Obsidia's word for a people's planet. She says a people that outgrows its host uses it up, while a purge leaves the host alive.

c56.name: the purge
c56.tip: Obsidia's word for the Enders ending a people's civilization. She says it begins when a host finds its people too prosperous.

c57.name: the black hole
c57.tip: A place in space so heavy it swallows whatever comes too near. Nothing seen falling in has come back out, not even light.

c57.name: Control Core
c57.tip: Whatever steers all the Enders, Chang'e says. It is hidden in the Will's dark void, and only destroying it can defeat the Will.

c58.name: the nest
c58.tip: The place where Obsidia's kind sleep until they are needed. Obsidia grew a thing of her own there that looks like a little girl.

c58.name: Ultimate Enders
c58.tip: The deadliest of the three Ender ranks Professor Joe teaches. They release the other two.

c58.name: pawn
c58.tip: Obsidia's word for the one of hers among the humans. The Will lets a pawn move freely for a while. If it slips beyond control, there is one outcome.

c59.name: Silverbolt
c59.tip: Selena's dragon-like machine, with blue light along its seams. Nobody else can run it, and Selena says it is shy.

c59.name: the storm night of 983
c59.tip: In 983 the Storm Citadel's violet storm kills every human machine, and Obsidia's Enders strike the sleeping city after midnight.

c60.name: the purple
c60.tip: Ender cells in Selena's blood. When she is cut, purple threads come up and draw the edges shut like a needle.

c60.name: the research base
c60.tip: A research base that stood before the Academy. Chang'e and her parents lived there, and later Lesley stood at its door.

c61.name: the fall of the research base
c61.tip: On the evening of the first light the alarm sounds and half the city burns. Small flying craft set the research base's storehouse on fire.

c61.name: the black-and-gold giant
c61.tip: A giant Ender hundreds of meters tall, black and gold, on tall thin legs, with huge curved blades hanging from its arms. It walks without hurry.

c62.phrase: No change to a registered mecha
c62.name: registration rule
c62.tip: Chang'e's rule: no change to a registered mecha without a field-test report and her mark. Any change, even paint.

c62.name: fine tuning
c62.tip: A machine tuned to one pilot answers no one else. Silverbolt is fine tuned, and so is the director's gear.

c63.name: the recall
c63.tip: An order written into the cells of one creature that says one thing: come back. Obsidia sends them to her pawn, and none is obeyed.

c63.name: Selena's thread
c63.tip: A thin thread Obsidia's pawn opened beside her recall. Reports come up it only on storm nights, when lightning hides it.

c64.name: the Singularity
c64.tip: A tear shaped like a four-pointed star, showing night sky over the bay. The Enders are widening it into a door to Vexana's world.

c64.name: the crews' yard
c64.tip: A yard far down the outer fence, where salvage crews sort their finds by day. After dark Selena sells salvage there under one lamp.

c65.name: the sea of stars
c65.tip: Space far from any world. Obsidia took the Storm Citadel out into it to watch, from there, what grew from her seed.

c66.name: Obsidia's throne
c66.tip: The Storm Citadel's spine, a humming column every block of the ship hangs from. Obsidia sits on it where a neck would be and moves the ship by touch.

c66.name: the cycle
c66.tip: Obsidia's view of history: peoples rise, are ended and begin again. She says destruction is merely the beginning of a new cycle.

c66.name: Obsidia's field
c66.tip: A field Obsidia built, asleep under her throne. Let out over the city, it would put out aspirant power wherever it reached, and nothing else.

c67.name: Obsidia's storm
c67.tip: A black cloud over the bay with violet light moving inside it, and something in it too big for any cloud.

c67.name: pink-haired keychain
c67.tip: A little pink-haired keychain doll of Guinevere. Guinevere pressed it into Vexana's palm at a stall: "Now you have me on yours."

c68.name: Emblems of Hope
c68.tip: Two gold stars Guinevere cut and soldered by hand, one for her collar and one for Vexana's. They glow gold when the partners' powers are in sync.

c69.name: Defensive Bubble
c69.tip: A dome of light over the city of Terrinia. It keeps the Enders out. A brighter patch of new light covers a tear from the last attack.

c69.name: frontline
c69.tip: Chang'e's frontline assault: Fanny, Layla and Guinevere, with Shield soldiers, students in suits and a long cannon, to meet the Enders head on.

c69.name: mobile support
c69.tip: Selena's battle post, set by Chang'e. Mobile support goes wherever the fight bends.

c70.name: Eternal Guards
c70.tip: Giant machines Vexana builds from Ender plate and cracked cores. They run on her power, and she means them to stand over Guinevere.

c70.name: the platforms
c70.tip: The broad stone tiers that join the city's wards above the bay. Three giants wait on the high ledges over them.

c71.name: the team test
c71.tip: A pair test. Two stand in a chalk square while steel dummies come down six rails at once, and a pair is out if a steel arm touches either.

c72.name: Mother Matrix
c72.tip: Chang'e's name for the body the readings suggest the Will of the Planet has: something vast, far out where nobody can see.

c72.name: purge protocol
c72.tip: An order from a voice everywhere: "Vexana. Execute purge protocol." To purge a place is to wipe it clean.

c72.name: wings of light
c72.tip: Wings of light that open at a pilot's back and let them fly. They run on aspirant power and go out like a switch when it is spent.

c73.name: the Will's mark
c73.tip: A cold point behind Vexana's breastbone. Through it the Will speaks, its Enders run with her, and its doors open wherever it sends her.

c73.name: the termination rule
c73.tip: Obsidia's rule for a thing she made: if it ever slips beyond control, there is only one outcome. Vexana named it: termination.

c74.name: Tetra
c74.tip: A doll no longer than a hand, a copy of Angela with pink hair and rabbit ears. Its left eye is a camera that feeds a monitor on Ruby's bench.

c74.name: androids
c74.tip: Machines built like people. On Oro they stand in rows: hundreds of the same girl.

c75.name: the lead Guard
c75.tip: The first of Vexana's Eternal Guards, a giant she built from Ender plates. It woke when she thought of Guinevere: eyes yellow, heart blazing magenta.

c76.name: the black hole
c76.tip: A place in space so heavy it swallows whatever comes too near. Nothing seen falling in has come back out, not even light.

c76.name: Control Core
c76.tip: Whatever steers all the Enders, Chang'e says. It is hidden in the Will's dark void, and only destroying it can defeat the Will.

c77.name: On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole
c77.tip: Chang'e's paper, marked Status: untested. It says an Aspirant's light would shine on inside a black hole and find its way home.

c78.name: The Aspirants always stand united
c78.tip: The Aspirants' shout. Everyone said it on the platforms, even Fanny, and the thought of it lights Guinevere's star.

c78.name: the recall
c78.tip: An order written into the cells of one creature that says one thing: come back. Obsidia sends them to her pawn, and none is obeyed.

c79.name: the Ender hum
c79.tip: The deep hum of the Enders that Selena feels in her bones. Every Ender carries a small piece of it. The Storm Citadel carries the whole.

c79.name: Storm Citadel
c79.tip: Obsidia's ship. It hangs over the bay inside its own black cloud, and wherever its violet storm reaches, human machines die.

c80.name: the bay road cut
c80.tip: A narrow street that climbs from the water to the shelters.

c80.name: Obsidia's field
c80.tip: A field Obsidia built, asleep under her throne. Let out over the city, it would put out aspirant power wherever it reached, and nothing else.

c81.name: Lesley's rifle
c81.tip: Lesley's long rifle. Its old firing action is a spring, a pin and a bolt that run on nothing but a hand, and she wants the new coil fitted on top.

c81.name: rear support
c81.tip: The post just behind the frontline: Angela's shield, the wounded and the way out. Chang'e posts Ruby and Angela there.

c82.name: the table of suits
c82.tip: A chart a teacher goes down in class: this year's suits, each kind and rank, and how strong each can run.

c82.name: rescue teams
c82.tip: The people who go into the ruins after a strike and carry out whoever is still alive.

c83.name: the barricade in the cut
c83.tip: A barricade of a door, a shop sign and a tipped car across the narrowest place in the cut, with a gap wide enough for one Ender at a time.

c84.name: the alley thing
c84.tip: Fanny's tactic: fight with your back to a narrow alley, so the Enders must come at you one or two at a time.

c84.name: Angela's cell
c84.tip: The cell inside Angela's body. It is her own, so the field that put out the suits does not stop her.

c85.name: the throne hall
c85.tip: Obsidia's hall deep among the Storm Citadel's hanging blocks, with no way in from outside. It is dark and huge, with wide stairs up into violet light.

c85.name: purification
c85.tip: Obsidia's word for destruction. She says destruction gives rise to new life, and that is the meaning of purification.

c85.name: Selena's true form
c85.tip: Selena's own shape: dark plate trimmed with silver, pale shards at her shoulders, horns, pointed ears, claws and fangs. She calls it the real her.

c86.name: crescents
c86.tip: Floating crescent pieces Chang'e builds to keep herself safe. White edged with pink, they rise and circle her.

c86.name: caramel pudding
c86.tip: A caramel pudding cup left outside Chang'e's lab door with no note, the spoon laid across the lid. Caramel is the right flavor.

c87.name: Obsidia's weapon
c87.tip: Obsidia's long silver-pink weapon. It comes to her hand out of the dark, and at the lift of one finger it lashes out across the hall.

c87.name: the nest
c87.tip: The place where Obsidia's kind sleep until they are needed. Obsidia grew a thing of her own there that looks like a little girl.

c87.phrase: a figure of silver and gold
c87.name: Obsidia's new form
c87.tip: A taller figure of silver and gold plate that Obsidia becomes in gold fire, with a crown of silver points and wings of energy wider than the storm.
